newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Chamber starts re-election voting process.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Chamber starts re-election voting process.

text.p: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies began the process of voting on a bill allowing presidential re-election, with deputies speaking for and against the constitutional amendment, officials said.
Congress officials said 326 deputies had officially registered their presence on the lower house floor while some 500 of a total of 513 deputies had registered their presence in the house.
To pass, the bill must be approved by at least 308 votes. It must pass twice through both the lower and upper houses.
A vote on the bill was expected later Tuesday evening if the government is convinced it has enough of its supporters on the lower house floor.
